purpose: Validate the same frozen investment targets in actual integer shares and independent dividend cash; not alpha selection
tax_scope: Cash distributions flat 20% stress reserve, not actual FIFO withholding; capital credits require applicable exemption proof
cash_credit: next explicit exchange session after announced payment date; receivable recognized at ex date
capital_credit: integer entitlement, credited no earlier than listing; no fractional-credit inference
price_clock: prior raw close sizes integer orders; next session open proxy executes; equity and inventory are prior-close inputs
limit_proxy: original direction-specific +/-9.5% relative to published reference; source isST must be 0 for execution validation
liquidity: Whole-day volume is a necessary feasibility check, not opening-auction fill proof
case_failure_policy: Keep and publish invalid capital cases; never select only favorable outcomes
